scope.purpose: Completeness/current-norm audit overlay; no canonical bank records are duplicated here.

internal_rosenthal_reference.evidence_note: Use verified project provenance only; no fresh direct primary-DOCX reread is claimed.

current_academic_crosscheck.source: Gramota.ru — dictionary: не обязанный / не обязан

current_norm_notes.не рад: explicitly covered by the academic separate-НЕ rule for short-only forms
current_norm_notes.не готов: dictionary/reference confirms separate spelling in predicative short use
current_norm_notes.не должен: orthographic dictionary and academic rule confirm separate spelling
current_norm_notes.не намерен: orthographic dictionary confirms separate spelling with infinitive
current_norm_notes.не обязан: orthographic dictionary fixes не обязанный; short form не обязан is separate

decisions.learner_policy: Keep the fixed separate spellings as a practical cluster, but do not force one historical part-of-speech label across all members.

current_norm_model.separate: preferred/common when direct negation is felt and obligatory with explicit negative-strengthening/context factors
current_norm_model.solid: несогласен can be admissible when an asserted negative quality is intended and no factor requires separate spelling

decisions.important_note: A bare universal rule 'НЕ СОГЛАСЕН is always separate' is too strong for current norm. The canonical identity should test context/meaning, while retaining не согласен as the default school orientation.
decisions.patch_policy: Change unit_type/learner metadata from one-form spelling anchor to contextual short-adjective spelling boundary; denominator count unchanged.

decisions.current_rule: НЕ is separate with these invariant predicative words; do not classify them as short adjectives.

current_model.не нужно: separate in predicative necessity meaning, e.g. не нужно строить, не нужно слов
current_model.ненужно: solid adverbial use is possible, e.g. говорит ненужно много

decisions.learner_policy: Never test the isolated string without function/syntax context.
decisions.patch_policy: Existing function-based identity is correct; keep it separate from generic НЕ-adverb ownership.

cumulative_audit_progress.note: Audit-work counter only; not a readiness percentage or learner-coverage metric.
